body.statement: On the real subclass with no measured substantive variables and no mleaf rows, and for \(\theta\in\Theta_{p,q,\ell}^{\mathrm{gen}}\), \(S_{vu}(W,\mathcal G(W,\ell),\ell)\) reduces to the normalized mixing-column effect set of latent-variable LiNGAM. On this shared generic subclass, \(|S_{vu}(W,\mathcal G(W,\ell),\ell)|=1\) if and only if the total effect of \(u\) on \(v\) satisfies Tramontano et al.'s unknown-graph criterion in Theorem 3.3.
body.justification: The reduction is the required sanity check that the mixed-model image agrees with the complete published criterion when measurement error disappears.
body.gap: The proposition claims equivalence only on the shared no-measurement generic subclass and does not relabel the published lvLiNGAM theorem as new.
body.consumer: Existing lvLiNGAM users obtain a backward-compatible effect image while gaining the mixed-model extension when noisy measurements are introduced.
